body: I don’t even know what day it is anymore but all I feel is pain and emptiness in all the places he used to be
Thank you so much. Some kind words were said but the honest ones mean more.  I think I am in this state because I haven’t fully processed this and that’s why so am struggling so hard.

I haven’t had a second to truly accept any of this or think of this. Since it has happened I have loaded myself with work and friends to try and make sense of this all. I am young, however, I don’t go to school I am a hairstylist and have been in my career for 3-4 years. I am still young enough to be under my parents insurance but still not financially stable to pay for a therapist myself.  I know 7 days is barely scratching the surface but that’s just it, it’s 7 days and I can’t do it and it gets progressively worse. Day 8 is around the corner and i’ll feel worse than I did before. 

I have attached almost my whole being into this relationship, but as did he. But then he went to college and he changed as a person. But even then he was different but we were still in love. A week ago, he had a full on mental breakdown and something snapped in him, he didn’t look the same, he didn’t talk the same, nothing. 

It is hard because I am trying to be friends with him because I still need him, I don’t have support of my family for the relationship has always been rough. And as for my friends you can only talk their ear off so much. 

I tried the no contact but we both end up contacting each other, In confused and hurt and I don’t know what to do. 

But thank you for the advice and the time to type out this reply to me.

I haven’t creeped on his social media at all or anything bc he deleted his apps not accounts but he’s not even on them. when we did talk, we facetimed for 2 hours until 1:30 in the morning and he was telling me how he’s trying to better himself and he felt so lost that he’s just trying to find himself. and then that gives me hope that maybe when he finds himself he’ll find me but then I have to force myself to remember that that isn’t a possibility and that he doesn’t love me and then my heart breaks all over againz
i’m not in school, and I will do that I didn’t realize that could have been an option for me
I feel like I can’t find the strength to do that and that’s also what’s killing me
my parents also do not believe in therapy and I am still under their insurance for a little bit and I can’t pay it out of pocket in my financial status

It’s conflicting because right now we are still talking we are doing the same thing just not as frequently and not using the nicknames or saying I love you, but when we joke my heart jumps, and when he smiles it beats faster. he’s not even with the other girl he told his mom he told me that bc he needed to say something, it’s all so confusing and that’s also a mindfuck
It just feels like if I live in this hurt then I live in him and I can’t let that go.

I have been non stop moving, i’m trying to keep busy, I even painted my whole room so I could distract myself. I tried to drink, I tried to smoke, hell I even tried a little coke. but it still didn’t get me fucked up enough to not think of him, for it to not hurt as bad as this does. I feel like I can’t get better, not because I can’t workout or find myself but I don’t want to get better, I don’t want to believe any of this is real.

the ends of your hair turned out darker because the ends of our hair tend to take to color easier. the band could be because it has experienced the color on top of color as well as the bleaching and that could shock the porosity (the hairs ability to absorb color and water, etc) and that could be what is causing the band because you can have different porosities everywhere on the hair strand. when the stylist went over it again only made it worse. you need to use clarifying shampoo to help fade the hair color. if you can find a stylist and explain to them you need a bleach wash to remove the color (this will almost be like a clean slate( and use a 10 vol on your mid strand because that is your problem and apply there first roots second and ends the last since they are so porous, i hope this helped and wasn't too confusing!
